latin: Si Syriani theologiam sequamur, rationabile est ecclesiasticae hierarchiae sacerdotes in coelesti hierarchia anagogicis uirtutibus proportionari.
translation: If we follow the theology of Syrianus, it is reasonable that the priests of the ecclesiastical hierarchy should correspond, in the celestial hierarchy, to the anagogic powers.
